# DICK'S Sporting Goods

> A major sporting goods retailer offering equipment, apparel, footwear, outdoor gear, team sports products, and in-store services.

DICK'S Sporting Goods sells products across sports, fitness, outdoor recreation, fan gear, golf, hunting, fishing, and athletic apparel. The site also includes store services, scorecard rewards, gift cards, order support, and seasonal shopping collections.

## Shop by Category
- [Sports & Fitness](https://www.dickssportinggoods.com/f/sports-and-fitness): Broad catalog for training equipment, team sports gear, and active essentials.
- [Exercise & Wellness](https://www.dickssportinggoods.com/f/exercise-and-wellness): Fitness machines, strength equipment, recovery tools, and wellness accessories.
- [Footwear](https://www.dickssportinggoods.com/f/footwear): Athletic shoes, cleats, boots, sandals, and casual footwear.
- [Clothing](https://www.dickssportinggoods.com/f/clothing): Men's, women's, and kids' athletic apparel and outerwear.
- [Outdoor Recreation](https://www.dickssportinggoods.com/f/outdoor-recreation): Camping, hiking, water sports, and outdoor activity gear.
- [Team Sports](https://www.dickssportinggoods.com/f/team-sports): Equipment, apparel, and accessories for organized sports and practice.
- [Fan Shop](https://www.dickssportinggoods.com/f/fan-shop): Licensed jerseys, apparel, and accessories for college and pro teams.
- [Golf](https://www.dickssportinggoods.com/f/golf): Clubs, balls, apparel, bags, and golf technology products.

## Fitness & Training
- [Treadmills](https://www.dickssportinggoods.com/f/treadmills): Home treadmills for walking, running, and connected fitness training.
- [Exercise Bikes](https://www.dickssportinggoods.com/f/exercise-bikes): Upright, recumbent, and indoor cycling bikes for home workouts.
- [Ellipticals](https://www.dickssportinggoods.com/f/ellipticals): Low-impact cardio machines for home exercise routines.
- [Home Gyms](https://www.dickssportinggoods.com/f/home-gyms): Multi-station systems and compact strength training setups.
- [Dumbbells](https://www.dickssportinggoods.com/f/dumbbells): Fixed and adjustable dumbbells for strength training.
- [Yoga & Pilates](https://www.dickssportinggoods.com/f/yoga-and-pilates): Mats, blocks, reformer accessories, and studio workout essentials.
- [Recovery & Massage](https://www.dickssportinggoods.com/f/recovery-and-massage): Massage guns, rollers, compression, and recovery tools.
